changes: Fix SMS storage: read and store messages in both the modem and the SIM card, prefer the modem's larger memory for new messages with automatic fallback when full, and show the message list in the correct chronological order.
Fix USSD on some Qualcomm modem revisions.
Open Wi-Fi networks work again: a client joining a network with no encryption now gets an address instead of being cut off right after it connects.
Hold the RESET button until the front panel flashes to restore factory settings.
New tool restores factory settings over TFTP, for a router that no longer boots.
